parts.title: Part 1 · Yes / No quiz
parts.instr: Read each question and answer Yes or No. Press ? if you did not understand. You lose 1 mark for each wrong answer; ? scores 0.

parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: in the physical sense. He rose early
and ran a mile before breakfast.
when she fell over the chair
that was lying on the floor. People sometimes feel a little sick
just before they have to make
a speech in public. What a pity!
The men had been fishing all day,

parts.text: We use “mind” in the abstract sense, whilst we use “brain” in the physical sense. He rose early and ran a mile before breakfast. She was glad she had not hurt herself when she fell over the chair that was lying on the floor. People sometimes feel a little sick just before they have to make a speech in public. What a pity! The men had been fishing all day, but had caught nothing.
